items.difficulty_reason: Equivalences for finite syntomic morphisms: the shared equivalences (1),(2),(3),(5),(6) delegate to the lqf sibling lemma, and the finite-specific (6) implies (4) is proved in span - NL perfect tor-amplitude [-1,0] forces I/I^2 locally free of rank n, free after semilocal localization and principal shrink, and the Huber lemma gives a presentation with equally many variables and equations. Retained author proof at lines 2301-2323.
